value.title: An Encounter with Bananya, Nya!
value.synopsis: A lone planet hangs in the universe. This colorful planet of blue skies, white clouds, and green earth is where Bananya spends his leisurely days. One day, Baby Sweet suddenly appears before Bananya. The two quickly become friends and set out on a wondrous journey.

value.title: Going Tropical with an Eternal Summer Mood, Nya!
value.synopsis: Baby Sweet starts glowing, and the next thing he knows, Bananya is on an island where summer lasts forever. Bananya and Baby Sweet join Eternal Summer Bananya in fun activities like surfing, free diving, and beach volleyball. As they're lounging in the sea, they see a dorsal fin cruising their way! Bananya and friends may be in trouble!

value.title: Rowdy Ruffians Race Across the Wastes, Nya!
value.synopsis: Bananya and Baby Sweet reach a wasteland where dry grasses tumble across the ground. As they're looking around, they suddenly find themselves surrounded by a bunch of Rowdy Bananyas. Then our very own Western Bananya shows up, and the desert showdown begins. Who will stand victorious?!

value.title: Hello Halloween, Nya!
value.synopsis: Bananya and Baby Sweet come across a coffin in a dark, gloomy mansion. As Bananya carefully investigates, a strange shadow appears behind him! Startled, the duo runs away as quickly as they can, but more mysterious shadows appear one after another, refusing to let them get away! Can Bananya and Baby Sweet escape the mansion?
